topics.briefDescription: External screens designed to extend the display area of a laptop, providing additional screen real estate for various tasks. These monitors are lightweight, easy to set up, and offer multiple connectivity options, making them versatile for different uses. They are ideal for multitasking, professional work, and gaming, catering to users who need more screen space on the go.

Music-tech company focused on transforming music creation and distribution through advanced technology. Boomy differentiates itself by offering tools that enable users to create original music quickly and easily, leveraging artificial intelligence to simplify the music production process. The platform is designed for aspiring musicians, content creators, and anyone interested in producing music without extensive technical knowledge.

Sealed packages containing a random item from a set, often used in the collectibles market to provide a surprise element. These boxes differentiate themselves by offering a sense of mystery and excitement, as buyers do not know which specific item they will receive until the box is opened. Blind boxes are primarily targeted at collectors and enthusiasts who enjoy the thrill of chance and the potential to complete a set of items.

Web3 video-sharing platform known for its anti-censorship stance and decentralized model. It allows users' PCs to act as servers for hosting and sharing videos, promoting free speech and reducing reliance on centralized servers. The platform primarily attracts users who value free speech and decentralized content distribution.

Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist (AIVA) is an AI-driven software that composes music. It leverages machine learning algorithms to create original musical compositions, which can be used in various creative fields such as film scoring, video game soundtracks, and personal projects. AIVA primarily benefits composers, musicians, and content creators looking for innovative and automated music composition solutions.

Free and open-source software designed for creating and animating sprites. It offers tools specifically tailored for pixel art and animation, making it a valuable resource for game developers and digital artists. The primary users of LibreSprite are game developers and digital artists focused on pixel art and sprite animations.

Platform offering high-quality 2D game assets for various projects, including game icons, sprites, tilesets, GUI elements, and characters. Craftpix distinguishes itself by providing both affordable and free game assets, catering to a wide range of game development needs. The platform primarily targets game developers and designers seeking cost-effective and visually appealing graphics for their projects.

A company founded in 2007 in Tucson, AZ, that creates merchandise inspired by popular video games. Fangamer offers a wide range of products including shirts, plushes, figures, books, prints, pins, and stickers, distinguishing itself with high-quality, officially licensed items that appeal to gaming enthusiasts. The target demographic for Fangamer includes fans of popular video games who are looking for unique and well-crafted merchandise to express their fandom.

Marketing agency based in Uppsala, Sweden, specializing in gaming influencer marketing. Wehype provides scalable, accessible, and effortless solutions to help game publishers and brands reach gaming communities worldwide, differentiating itself by connecting creators with games. Their services are primarily targeted at game publishers and brands looking to leverage influencer marketing to engage with gaming audiences.

Media server software that allows users to manage and stream their media collections. As an open-source alternative to other media server solutions like Plex and Emby, it offers features such as no subscription fees, full control over media, support for live TV and DVR, and transcoding capabilities. Jellyfin is ideal for individuals who prefer customizable, open-source solutions for their media streaming needs.

Platform that provides tools and analytics for gamers, particularly those who play competitive games like Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO). It helps players improve their skills by analyzing their gameplay, offering insights, and suggesting areas for improvement through advanced algorithms. The platform is primarily targeted at competitive gamers seeking to enhance their performance and gain a deeper understanding of their gameplay.

Platform where users can virtually track their game collection, keep their backlog updated, rate the games they've played, and add upcoming games to their wishlist. It differentiates itself by providing a comprehensive and user-friendly interface for managing and reviewing video game collections, enhancing the gaming experience through community engagement and personalized recommendations. Backloggd primarily targets gamers who want to organize their game libraries, share their gaming experiences, and discover new titles.

Phantasma is a blockchain platform designed for digital goods and services, including gaming, NFTs, and decentralized applications. It differentiates itself by offering high transaction speeds, low fees, and a dual-token system (SOUL and KCAL) to facilitate various functionalities within its ecosystem. Phantasma primarily targets developers, gamers, and digital content creators looking for a versatile and efficient blockchain solution.

Music collection manager designed for Usenet and BitTorrent users, enabling efficient management of music libraries. It monitors multiple RSS feeds for new tracks or albums from favorite artists and automatically downloads, sorts, and renames them, streamlining the process of acquiring and organizing music files. Lidarr is particularly useful for music enthusiasts who frequently download music and seek an automated solution to manage their collections.

Cloud-based platform designed for podcasters and content creators to produce high-quality audio and video content. It offers tools for recording, managing, and editing audio clips, and supports collaboration through chat and Voice Over Internet Protocol (VOIP) functionality, distinguishing itself with its user-friendly interface. Zencastr is suitable for both beginners and professionals looking to streamline their podcast production process.

Platform that provides fully uncensored chats, allowing users to save chats, favorite chatbots, and create their own characters. Spicychat offers both free and premium accounts, with the premium service providing reduced waiting times, differentiating it from other chat platforms. The platform primarily targets users seeking unrestricted chat experiences and customizable chatbot interactions.

A fast-growing digital entertainment supplier operating in 23 regulated markets with over 200 partners worldwide. The company offers a diverse portfolio of online casino games, known for their engaging mathematical design and appealing aesthetics, setting it apart from competitors. Playson primarily targets online casino operators and players seeking high-quality, engaging gaming experiences.

Interactive live-streaming application designed to enhance engagement between creators and their audience. It offers unique features that allow creators to interact in real-time, fostering a more dynamic and engaging experience compared to traditional streaming platforms. The application primarily targets content creators and influencers looking to build a more interactive and engaged community.

A small chick or the young of a bird, often characterized by its soft, downy feathers and high-pitched chirping. These young birds are typically dependent on their parents for food and protection until they mature enough to fend for themselves. The term 'kiti' is commonly used in various cultures to refer to the early stages of a bird's life, appealing to bird enthusiasts and ornithologists studying avian development.

An immersive and interactive attraction with multiple locations, offering a variety of ice cream-themed exhibits and tasting experiences. It is known for its vibrant, Instagram-worthy displays and provides a unique, playful environment that differentiates it from traditional museums. The Museum of Ice Cream primarily targets families, tourists, and social media enthusiasts looking for a fun and visually engaging experience.

Slovenian video game developer known for creating the Talking Tom & Friends app and media franchise. The company differentiates itself by producing interactive and engaging mobile games that have garnered a large global user base, particularly among younger audiences. Outfit7 primarily targets children and casual gamers who enjoy character-driven, interactive entertainment.

Rating system that provides clubs and organizations with universal, real-time ratings for pickleball players. The system is based solely on players' results, ensuring objectivity and accuracy in player rankings across various competitive contexts such as leagues, organized play, tournaments, and round robins. DUPR is beneficial for pickleball clubs, organizations, and players seeking a standardized and reliable method for assessing player performance.

Japanese entertainment and gaming company founded in 1969, known for developing and publishing a variety of video games, trading card games, anime, tokusatsu, slot machines, and arcade cabinets. It differentiates itself with famous video game franchises such as 'Metal Gear,' 'Silent Hill,' 'Castlevania,' 'Contra,' and 'Pro Evolution Soccer,' which have garnered a significant following. Konami primarily targets gamers and entertainment enthusiasts worldwide, offering a diverse range of products and experiences.

Open-source application designed to manage and automate the downloading and organizing of movies. It monitors multiple RSS feeds for new movie releases, automatically downloads them, and organizes them into a user-friendly library, supporting various download clients and integrating with services like Plex and Emby for media server management. Radarr is primarily used by movie enthusiasts and individuals who maintain extensive digital movie libraries.

A 3D modeling program designed for creating and editing low-poly models, particularly for use in Minecraft. It is widely used by Minecraft modders and resource pack creators to design custom models and animations, supporting various formats and offering features like texture painting, animation, and model exporting. Blockbench primarily benefits game developers, modders, and digital artists who focus on Minecraft content creation.

Company specializing in providing financing solutions for the film, television, and media industries. Founded in 2014 and backed by Accord Financial Inc., it offers flexible and reliable financing options for various projects and media companies, differentiating itself through its industry-specific expertise and tailored financial products. BondIT primarily serves filmmakers, production companies, and media enterprises seeking financial support for their projects.

Online marketplace that caters to independent digital creators, particularly those developing indie video games. Itch.io provides a platform for developers to upload, distribute, and sell their games and other digital content, offering flexible pricing models and participation in game jams and bundles. The platform primarily benefits indie game developers and digital content creators seeking a supportive and flexible marketplace to reach their audience.

Video streaming application that enables users to watch and organize video content from various services, including movies, series, live TV, and video channels. It differentiates itself by offering a unified interface that aggregates content from multiple sources, providing a seamless viewing experience. Stremio is targeted at individuals who seek a comprehensive and user-friendly platform to manage and enjoy diverse video content.

Brand specializing in gaming accessories, particularly chargers for gaming controllers. Oivo offers a variety of products designed to enhance the gaming experience, including chargers for Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and other gaming controllers, differentiating itself with reliable and convenient charging solutions. The target demographic includes gamers seeking dependable and efficient charging options for their gaming controllers.

Free text-to-speech tool and online text reader that converts text to speech. It supports over 100 languages and offers more than 100 voice styles, providing a versatile solution for various text-to-speech needs. TTSMaker is beneficial for individuals and businesses seeking an accessible and multilingual text-to-speech service.

Statistic used in baseball to measure a player's total contributions to their team in terms of wins, compared to a replacement-level player. bWAR quantifies a player's overall performance, including batting, fielding, and baserunning, to provide a comprehensive value of their impact on the team's success. This metric is particularly useful for baseball analysts, team managers, and fans who seek to evaluate player performance beyond traditional statistics.

Mass-consumer Web3 company aiming to connect non-crypto-native fans to iconic brands, artists, and athletes. Built on the Tezos and Polygon blockchains, Oneof is a green NFT platform focused on music, sports, and lifestyle, offering affordable NFTs that can be purchased with various payment methods. It targets fans of music, sports, and lifestyle who are interested in digital collectibles and NFTs.

Concept that represents a spiritual life force or healing power in Oceanian cultures, and is also used in various other contexts. In Mandaeism, it is equivalent to 'nous', while in religious texts like the Bible and Quran, it refers to an edible substance. In gaming and fantasy literature, mana is commonly used as a resource for magical abilities, appealing to gamers and fantasy enthusiasts.

Reelo is a mobile application designed to enhance user engagement on the Bluesky social platform by providing a swipeable vertical video feed, similar to TikTok. It offers familiar interaction features such as liking, commenting, and sharing, aiming to create a more dynamic and interactive user experience. Reelo primarily targets Bluesky users seeking an enriched and engaging way to interact with content on the platform.

Media server and client-server media player platform that allows users to organize, stream, and access their personal media libraries, such as movies, TV shows, music, and photos, from various devices. It offers both free and premium (Plex Pass) versions, with the premium version providing additional features like live TV and DVR, mobile sync, and more. Plex is ideal for individuals who want a centralized solution to manage and stream their personal media collections across multiple devices.

Tabletop role-playing games (TTRPGs) are a form of game where players assume the roles of characters in a fictional setting, guided by a set of rules and a game master. These games emphasize storytelling, character development, and collaborative problem-solving, often using dice and other tools to determine the outcomes of actions. TTRPGs appeal to individuals who enjoy immersive storytelling, creative expression, and social interaction in a structured yet imaginative environment.

Brand specializing in outdoor equipment, including camping and hiking gear, tents, and trekking poles. Overmont differentiates itself by offering durable and reliable products designed to enhance outdoor experiences, catering to both casual campers and serious adventurers. The brand primarily targets outdoor enthusiasts and individuals seeking high-quality gear for their camping and hiking activities.

An Australian company specializing in distributing Panini NBA products and trading cards for games like Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Magic: The Gathering. Cherry Collectables differentiates itself by offering services for buying and selling cards and is associated with Beckett BGS for card grading, ensuring high-quality and authenticated products. The company primarily targets trading card enthusiasts and collectors looking for a reliable source for both purchasing and grading their collections.

Entertainment company based in Tel Aviv, Israel, specializing in the development of multiplayer match-3 games. Candivore differentiates itself by focusing on engaging, social gaming experiences that connect players worldwide through competitive and cooperative gameplay. The company's primary audience includes casual gamers and fans of puzzle games who enjoy interactive and social gaming experiences.

Humanitix is a non-profit ticketing platform that directs its booking fees towards funding education projects and social causes. The platform differentiates itself by using its revenue to support various charities and educational initiatives, creating a positive impact through the simple act of purchasing event tickets. Humanitix primarily targets event organizers and attendees who are conscious about social impact and wish to support charitable causes through their transactions.

Noping is the present participle of 'nope,' used informally to express a strong or humorous refusal or rejection. It is often employed in casual conversations or online interactions to convey a decisive or emphatic 'no' in a lighthearted manner. Noping is typically used by individuals seeking to add a playful or humorous tone to their refusals or rejections.

This radio station, based in Wisconsin, broadcasts a variety of content including news, sports, and adult contemporary music. Serving areas such as Manitowoc, Two Rivers, Sheboygan, Algoma, and Kewaunee, it has been on air since 1926, making it one of the long-standing stations in the region.

Project that creates highly detailed, 3D models of the human brain at microscopic resolution. It is the first openly accessible model of its kind, providing valuable data for scientific research and advancing our understanding of the human brain. The BigBrain project primarily benefits neuroscientists, researchers, and medical professionals seeking detailed anatomical data for their studies.

A spoofer is a tool or technique used to deceive or manipulate data, signals, or identities in various contexts, particularly in technology, cybersecurity, and telecommunications. It includes methods like email spoofing, IP spoofing, DNS spoofing, GPS spoofing, caller ID spoofing, and MAC address spoofing, often employed in malicious activities to gain unauthorized access, steal data, or spread malware. Spoofers are typically used by cybercriminals and hackers to exploit vulnerabilities and carry out fraudulent activities.

Technology platform that automates the complex and inefficient estate planning process. It streamlines execution complexity and manual workflows, reducing risk and expanding opportunities for use, differentiating itself by offering a more efficient and less error-prone solution compared to traditional methods. Luminary primarily targets legal professionals, financial advisors, and individuals seeking a more streamlined and reliable estate planning process.

Company that designs and manufactures water bottles known for their innovative and user-friendly designs. Owala® differentiates itself with features like the FreeSip bottle, which combines a straw and spout for versatile drinking options, and emphasizes creating products that encourage hydration. Their water bottles are popular among individuals seeking BPA-free, insulated stainless steel options for sports, travel, and everyday use.

News aggregator and online community website created by Drew Curtis in 1999. The site allows users to submit links to news articles, which are reviewed by administrators and posted on the main page if deemed interesting or humorous, known for its humorous and often irreverent take on current events. Fark primarily attracts users who enjoy engaging with a community that comments on and discusses various news stories.

Vehicle simulation game that uses soft-body physics to simulate realistic vehicle dynamics and collisions. It features highly detailed and accurate physics algorithms optimized for realistic vehicle behavior, providing an immersive driving experience. The game is popular among simulation enthusiasts who seek a high level of realism in vehicle dynamics and collisions.

Software company based in Auckland, New Zealand, specializing in marketing data analytics and campaign management solutions for the cinema industry. Recognized as a global leader, Movio provides innovative solutions tailored to address the unique challenges of movie marketing, leveraging the world's most comprehensive source of moviegoer data to optimize campaigns. The primary beneficiaries of Movio's services are cinemas and movie marketers seeking to enhance their marketing strategies and improve audience engagement.

AI-powered podcast player that creates transcripts for podcast episodes, allowing users to follow along as they listen. It enables users to discover, save, and share highlights from podcasts, search for moments in the transcript, get summaries, and share clips, differentiating itself with its advanced AI capabilities. Snipd is particularly useful for podcast enthusiasts who want to enhance their listening experience and easily manage podcast content.

Platform that has reinvented the way gamers enhance their gaming experience by offering services such as traditional boosting and allowing users to buy and sell in-game items and services. Overgear differentiates itself by providing a comprehensive marketplace for gamers to improve their gaming time through various options, including skill enhancement and item acquisition. The platform primarily targets gamers looking to optimize their in-game performance and overall experience.

British gambling company founded in 1972, headquartered in Nuneaton, UK. It operates over 148 high street venues and has an online presence, offering services such as slot machines, electronic roulette, and other gaming machines, distinguishing itself with a wide range of gaming options. The company primarily targets adults seeking entertainment through gambling activities.

Tool used for applying post-processing effects to games and other 3D applications. It enhances the visual quality of these applications by allowing users to add various effects such as color correction, depth of field, and ambient occlusion, differentiating itself by its extensive customization options. Reshade is primarily targeted at gamers and developers looking to improve the visual aesthetics of their applications.

Near-Eye Tool for Refractive Assessment (Netra) is a system developed by the Media Lab's Camera Culture research group for vision measurement and correction. The device is a small plastic tool that allows users to perform refractive assessments, helping to identify and correct vision issues. Netra is particularly useful for individuals needing vision correction, such as those with myopia or hyperopia, and aims to provide an accessible and cost-effective solution for eye care.

A classical percussion instrument from South India, commonly used in Carnatic music performances. It is a double-headed drum, with each side producing different pitches, and is known for its complex rhythmic patterns and intricate playing techniques. The Mridangam is primarily used by musicians and performers in the realm of South Indian classical music.

Online platform that supports authors in creating and serializing their stories, including novels and comics. It allows readers to access free chapters and continue reading by purchasing subsequent chapters, providing a flexible reading experience based on user preferences. Webnovel primarily targets aspiring writers and avid readers looking for diverse and serialized content.

Metronaut is an app designed to empower musicians to play any instrument, including their voice, as if they had a real orchestra accompanying them. The app provides a virtual orchestral accompaniment, allowing users to practice and perform with a full ensemble, enhancing their musical experience and practice sessions. Metronaut is particularly beneficial for musicians of all skill levels who seek a more immersive and interactive practice environment.

Digital platform and app offering a streaming service for e-books and audiobooks. Founded in 2015, it provides access to over 300,000 books in various digital formats, with options for unlimited reading or listening based on subscription plans. The service is targeted at book enthusiasts and individuals seeking convenient access to a wide range of literary content, including offline options for travel.

Comprehensive booking system designed for racket sports venues globally, aimed at enhancing the enjoyment, ease, and accessibility of racket sports. MATCHi offers a user-friendly platform that allows players to book courts, find partners, and participate in events, differentiating itself with its focus on the racket sports community. The primary users of MATCHi are racket sports enthusiasts, venue managers, and event organizers seeking a streamlined and efficient booking experience.

A neutral marketplace that facilitates player-to-player trading for a variety of popular online games. It supports trading for games such as RuneScape, World of Warcraft, CSGO, and many others, providing a secure platform for buying and selling in-game items, accounts, and currencies. Playerauctions primarily targets gamers looking to enhance their gaming experience through the acquisition of virtual goods and services.

Aimlabs is an aim-training shooter game developed and published by State Space Labs, Inc., designed to help players practice and optimize their gameplay in first or third-person shooter settings. It differentiates itself by incorporating insights from neuroscientists, designers, developers, and computer vision experts, offering a scientifically-backed approach to improving aim and reaction times. The game primarily targets gamers looking to enhance their shooting skills, available on platforms such as Microsoft Windows, Android, and iOS.

Splendor is a popular board game where players take on the roles of Renaissance merchants aiming to acquire the most prestige points. The game involves collecting gems and developing trade routes to build a prosperous business, with strategic planning and resource management being key elements. Splendor is primarily enjoyed by board game enthusiasts and families looking for a strategic and engaging game experience.

PatchBot is a Discord bot designed to deliver patch notes and game updates directly to channels. It organizes updates into specific threads, allows role mentions for notifications, automatically pins updates, and offers customization options for selecting which games to follow, providing a streamlined way to stay informed about game changes. PatchBot is particularly useful for gaming communities and Discord server administrators who want to keep their members updated on the latest game developments efficiently.

Online marketplace and community dedicated to LEGO products, including sets, parts, and minifigures. It provides an extensive catalog and tools for managing collections and creating custom builds, making it a valuable resource for finding rare and discontinued items. BrickLink primarily serves LEGO enthusiasts and collectors looking for specific or hard-to-find LEGO components.
